# future_analysis-reports

Daily futures swing strategy reports — auto-published from the
[future_analysis](https://github.com/zhiwenliang/future_analysis) workspace
by `python3 -m future_analysis.cli publish-report`.

**This repository is a machine archive.** Do not edit files here by hand —
the publisher overwrites local state on each run. To report issues or
suggest changes, open them in the source repo.
